title: Tamacha maare
body:
dil pe kya guzregi behno ko jo bazaron mein
bhai ke saamne gar koi tamacha maare
dasht o sehra mein gali koochon mein darbaron mein
bhai ke saamne gar koi tamacha maare
<<DIVIDER>>
dil laraz jaata hai bhai ka khayalon se bhi
zikr kya kije andheron ka ujalon se bhi
mehfile ghair mein pardes mein ghaddaron mein
bhai ke saamne gar koi tamacha maare
dil pe kya guzregi...
<<DIVIDER>>
naaz behno ka to maa'on ka jigar hota hai
baap ke baad to bhai hi padar hota hai
kalma goyon mein muhajir mein aur ansaron mein
bhai ke saamne gar koi tamacha maare
dil pe kya guzregi...
<<DIVIDER>>
bhai bhi aisa ho ghamkhwar hamiyat waala
hashmi ghairat o ehsaas o jalalat waala
dil phata jaata hai ye soch ke ghaddaron mein
bhai ke saamne gar koi tamacha maare
dil pe kya guzregi...
<<DIVIDER>>
har tamache pe jo bechain bahot hoti ho
dekh kar bhai ke chehre ko behan roti ho
naizabardaron gunahgaron khatakaaron mein
bhai ke saamne gar koi tamacha maare
dil pe kya guzregi...
<<DIVIDER>>
aisi mazlooma ko gar zulm o sitam ke baani
shiddate pyaas mein dikhlake bahade pani
ghudkiyan deke sar e raah sitamgaaron mein
bhai ke saamne gar koi tamacha maare
dil pe kya guzregi...
<<DIVIDER>>
sabr is raah mein aaye bhi to aaye kaise
bhai zanjeeron mein jakda hai bachaye kaise
haye chalta hai jo kanton mein aur angaron mein
bhai ke saamne gar koi tamacha maare
dil pe kya guzregi...
<<DIVIDER>>
baap ka sar jo sitamgaar dikhaye aa kar
ek masoom si bachi ko rulaye aa kar
teer o samsheer o chamakti hui talwaron mein
bhai ke saamne gar koi tamacha maare
dil pe kya guzregi...
<<DIVIDER>>
baad karbal na kabhi chain se soye abid
bas yehi soch ke ta zindagi roye abid
fatema zehra ki poti ko jo aghyaron mein
bhai ke saamne gar koi tamacha maare
dil pe kya guzregi...
<<DIVIDER>>
dard ainee koi abid ke jigar se pooche
ya phir aamir zara shabbir ke sar se pooche
wo namak khwaron jafakaron mein maikharon mein
bhai ke saamne gar koi tamacha maare
dil pe kya guzregi...
author: Ainee Rizvi
